subject: Re: Azure private offer — SKU bucket rescope & channel passback alignment
messages:
From: Anita Patel <anita@cloudscale.io>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: TwoCloud Reseller <partner-sales@tcr.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure private offer — need to rescope SKU buckets

Hi Irene / Ben,

Quick context: CloudScale is moving their Q1 forecast up and we’re concerned their committed SKU mix in the proposed Azure private offer won’t match actual usage. The original bucket allocation was conservative for commit purposes, but with the revised forecast they expect heavy consumption in the GPU-inference SKU (AZ-INF-GPU) for a 6–8 week window.

Ask: can we re-scope the SKU buckets so the INF-GPU band increases by ~40% during the first 3 months, and introduce an overage credit for the reseller passback for any usage that exceeds the committed tier? They want to avoid a retroactive large invoice for the reseller.

Also cc’ing our reseller partner; they’ll need to confirm passback tolerance on their end.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call today if useful.

— Anita
Anita Patel
Head of CloudOps, CloudScale Inc.
anita@cloudscale.io
+1 415 555 0198

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Patel <anita@cloudscale.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, TwoCloud Reseller <partner-sales@tcr.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — need to rescope SKU buckets

Anita — thanks for the heads up. We can accommodate a reshuffle, but want to align on two things up-front so we avoid multiple contract amendments:

1) Margin neutrality for the reseller — they’ve asked that any overage credit doesn’t meaningfully reduce their effective margin.
2) Clear trigger and lookback window for overage credits so we can operationalize billing and reporting.

Proposed short plan:
- Ben will draft a margin water-fall showing list price / private-offer unit price / reseller passback for the current vs proposed SKU mix.
- If the reseller agrees, we’ll issue an amendment that: (a) increases INF-GPU committed bucket for the first 90 days, (b) defines an overage credit equal to 50% of the passback for usage between 100–125% of the bucket, and (c) preserves the reseller’s floor margin.

Can you confirm the 40% increase target and the exact dates for the 90-day window? Also please share the revised forecast CSV when you have it.

I’ll loop Vanessa to coordinate the partner passback text.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic GTM — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Anita Patel <anita@cloudscale.io>
Cc: TwoCloud Reseller <partner-sales@tcr.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:54:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — margin workback + SKU proposal (attached)

Attaching a quick workback (AZ_SKU_reshuffle_v3.xlsx) and a one-pager PDF showing the channel margin waterfall. High level:

- Option A (fast re-scope): shift 40% of initial INF-GPU units into the committed first-90-days bucket, keep unit prices identical. Reseller passback stays at current % but we apply an overage credit as Irene suggested. Impact: revenue timing shifts to earlier months, negligible impact to overall contract ARR.
- Option B (protect reseller margin): raise list price for INF-GPU by 6% and increase passback floor to preserve reseller margin if CloudScale hits >110% utilization. This keeps Redwood unit economics intact while giving the reseller the same or slightly better effective margin.

Notes on implementation:
- Overage credit mechanics: prorated credit at month-end; credit applied to reseller settlement not customer invoice.
- Billing ops needs a defined flag in the PO to trigger the 90-day reshuffle — recommend field "TEMP_SKU_REALLOC=Q4-2026-90".

Next steps:
- Anita: confirm dates and final forecast (CSV).
- Partner: confirm they can accept a credit applied to their settlement (partner passback) and that it won’t create a reconciliation burden.
- Irene/Vanessa: if partner OK, I’ll produce a redline for the amendment (amendment_redline.docx) and we’ll send to legal/finance for expedited review.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: AZ_SKU_reshuffle_v3.xlsx)
(attachment: Channel_Margin_Waterfall.pdf)

From: TwoCloud Reseller <partner-sales@tcr.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Patel <anita@cloudscale.io>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — margin workback + SKU proposal (attached)

Thanks for the loop — quick reply from the partner side: we can accept an overage credit on our settlement but need two protections:

- A monthly cap on credits (suggest $20k/month) to avoid runaway credits against our operating cash flow.
- A reconciliation schedule (monthly statements) with a maximum 30-day lag; any disputes beyond that period are closed.

We also prefer Option B if Redwood can keep the passback percentage stable — moving the list price up 6% and keeping passback the same preserves our margins and reduces reconciliation frequency.

If Redwood/legal can insert both protections into the amendment, we’ll sign quickly. Otherwise we’ll require a short 1-week pilot where we accept Option A with a cap and then move to Option B if volumes stay high.

— Mateo (on behalf of TwoCloud Reseller)
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Partnerships, TwoCloud Reseller
partner-sales@tcr.com

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Patel <anita@cloudscale.io>, TwoCloud Reseller <partner-sales@tcr.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — margin workback + SKU proposal (final next steps)

Thanks everyone — aligned on a pragmatic path forward:

- We’ll proceed with Option B as the preferred long-term outcome: +6% list price on INF-GPU, keep passback % unchanged, and insert a reseller protection clause that enforces a monthly credit cap of $20k and a 30-day reconciliation window.
- As a transitional safety, we’ll accept a 2-week pilot under Option A while legal finalizes the amendment wording. Pilot will include the monthly cap and auto-conversion to Option B if utilization >110% for any 2-week contiguous period.
- Ben to upload the final amendment redline by EOD tomorrow and I’ll route to legal and finance. Once approved we’ll send to CloudScale for signature (DocuSign link will be included).

Anita — can you confirm the start date for the 90-day reshuffle window? Once we have that we’ll lock dates in the amendment and schedule the pilot start.

Action items:
- Anita: confirm start date + send forecast CSV (due 10/09 EOD).
- Ben: finalize amendment_redline.docx and share.
- TwoCloud: confirm acceptance of monthly cap and pilot terms.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aim to have pilot live by 10/12.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic GTM — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
(related links: https://hubspot.example/Deal/CS-2026-AZ-004; DocuSign will follow)
